info.title: Eliq Data Management API
info.description:
# API Reference

The Eliq data management API is organized around REST. The API accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses and uses standard HTTP response codes. The URLs are all resource oriented around Eliq's three main entities; User, Location and Meter

# Errors

Eliq Integration API uses standard HTTP response codes to indicate success or failure of a request. Codes with 2xx indicate success, 4xx indicate error due to invalid input, and 5xx indicates an error in Eliq Integration API.

## Status codes

*Status code* | *Description*
--- | ---
200 - OK | Everything worked as expected.
201 - Created | Resource created.
202 - Accepted | Successful request, and will be handled later. A reference id will be available in the response body.
204 - No Content | Successful request. Used in successful delete requests
400 - Bad Request | Request input data is invalid.
401 - Unauthorized | Access token invalid for the given request. Eg. access token expired.
404 - Not Found | Requested resource not found
500, 502, 503, 504 | Something wrong with Eliq Integration API

## Error body

Eliq Integration API returns an error response body on failures to provide additional information on the error. Please find the error body and description below.

```json
{
    "code":"< ERROR CODE >",
    "description":"< DESCRIPTION OF ERROR >",
    "request_id":"16a3ae43-ca5f-455e-9aef-f93679bedc8d"
}
```

*Field* | *Type* | *Description*
--- | --- | ---
code | String | Error code. Possible error codes per request can be found in each request section. Error codes do not change, and can be used to tie actions to.
description | String | A description of the error for developers
request_id | String | Identifier of the request. Passed when in contact with support

## Request ID

Each API request has an associated request id. You can find this value in the response headers, under X-Request-Id. The request id can be used in communication with Eliq support.
